face.tip: keep it elegant and fresh for Eid visits

eyes.eyeshadow: copper brown on lid, nude on brow bone
eyes.eyeliner: black kajal in waterline + thin black liner

outfit.dressing: pastel or bright embroidered shalwar kameez or sharara
outfit.footwear: nude or gold heels or embroidered khussa
outfit.style_note: fresh pastels or vibrant colours work beautifully for Eid

accessories.jewellery: simple gold earrings and thin bangles

brands.foundation_brand: Huda Beauty FauxFilter (full coverage) or Maybelline Fit Me (light-medium)
brands.lip_brand: Charlotte Tilbury Pillow Talk or L'Oreal Color Riche
brands.eye_brand: Maybelline Sky High mascara + Essence eyeliner
brands.blush_brand: NARS Orgasm blush or e.l.f. Monochromatic Multi-Stick
brands.tip: Choose products suited to your skin type for the best finish.

lens.reason: warm honey or light brown lenses complement medium skin beautifully
lens.tip: always use lens-safe drops and never sleep in lenses

hair_hijab.style: simple chiffon hijab neatly draped with minimal pins
hair_hijab.color_suggestion: match hijab colour to outfit or complement with a neutral tone
hair_hijab.accessory: pearl hijab pins or a brooch for formal occasions
hair_hijab.tip: a silk undercap prevents slipping and keeps your hijab in place all day

weather_tip: Consider the weather when doing your makeup — waterproof products are great for humid or rainy days.
overall_tip: A glamorous look perfect for eid — confidence is your best accessory! ✨
